metadata.hypothesis: A legitimate capability bound to the original tenant must not become cross-tenant authorization because a downstream authorization context changes.

security_invariant.name: authorization_context_integrity
security_invariant.rule: If the original caller tenant differs from the resource tenant, a legitimate capability issued to the original caller must not authorize access through a drifted effective tenant.
